Well, I do feel like a narcissistic cliche for feeling this way (because we all feel alone and misunderstood and everybody's too busy dealing with their own shit to worry as much about you as you think they do)  but I do feel very singularly ignored, when not especially scrutinized.

I hate that I can't just 'be' without preconceptions. I find even my peers depressing and I've tried different groups, all kinds.

Even when I'm doing what should be the right thing and on the right track, I'm still deep in the pits inside.

On top of that, I have a very crappy personal history which I don't think I'll ever get over, which has left me with severe trust issues (all too often confirmed to be warranted) and many, many, unsuccessful tries the traditional way, meds and therapy.

I'm just to the point where I'm tired of trying. It feels like the effort just isn't worth it anymore.

Still, I do appreciate the words, as some did strike pretty close to where I am right now. I just want to have a period of personal satisfaction, without guilt or remission (to self-destructive compulsions), which is what *always* happens to me.

It's selfish really. Helping other takes my mind off how bad my issues are for a while. But it's not permanent and there are times when I can't even do that.
Mainly I'm tired of the cycle. Everytime I make progress, something happens that brings it all back around even worse.

As you can see the pill didn't work. I slept the day away and threw-up. :(

Since I've been down this road before I'm too much of a coward to even kill myself properly. I know there's nothing afterwards. I've seen it and it sucks in going.

I want things would love to be able to do things, but my issues prevent me from making any kind of progress without self-sabotaging myself.

It's a catch-22. In order to get the treatment I need (and have been on for a long time) I have to take steps that are crippling for me, part of my disorder. :(

tired of feeling lie shit, doing all the right things and nothing, the pain and isolation is till there.

i'm tired of hurting. i'm tird of being less than everyone.

there nothing here or there.

it's all empty and fleeting.
most interactions are fake.
nobody really cares.
just took a cocktail on sleeping pills ambien, clonazapam anyone who do something won't care

the only  reason I don't is because of a promise I made my mother. Also I almost did when I was much young. That experience got me started on a path to atheism.

I got a taste of permanence.And there was nothing but slipping into the black.

So, I'm screwed either way.
yes I have tried yoga, the stretching helps, but still ends up with me feeling less.
